versions.content: Missing SwDataDefProps . swAddrMethod If the association SwDataDefProps . swAddrMethod is missing the object can be placed anywhere without restriction, e.g. using a default behavior of the RTE generator. Contradict- ing specifications (e.g. two different component types request different associations for one particular SwAddrMethod ) shall be flagged as an error.
